title: Results step: show object word at top, move score below highlighted text
story: As a designer, I want the object word shown at the top of the results step (like on the analyzing step), and the score moved below the highlighted text.
acceptance_criteria: The object word is displayed at the top of the results step with the same visual treatment as the word prompt on the analyzing step
The score is positioned below the entire highlighted text component (including the color legend)
The order of elements in the results step is: object word, highlighted text, score, start new exercise button

title: Add documentation philosophy guide for agents
agent_retro: The user interrupted two edits mid-execution — once to redirect the src/services/ line wording, and once to also remove the /pick-ticket section. Both corrections were reasonable and came from applying the new philosophy to existing content, but I had already started executing before fully auditing all existing docs against it.
story: As a developer, I want agent-facing guidelines on documentation philosophy so that agents produce documentation that stays accurate and close to the code it describes.
acceptance_criteria: A documentation philosophy guide exists and is visible to the agent during task execution
The guide specifies that documentation should live close to the code it documents, not in a centralized docs/ folder
The guide specifies that documentation should avoid exact file paths and variable names
Existing documentation and markdown files are updated to remove exact file paths and folder names

title: Move custom command logic into standalone scripts
story: As a developer, I want portions of custom commands that can be extracted into Python/Bash/Node scripts to be moved there, so that logic is reusable and not dependent on LLM execution.
acceptance_criteria: All custom commands and ticket/sprint workflow are audited for LLM interactions that could be replaced by scripts
Reasonable replacement candidates are surfaced to the developer for approval before implementation
Approved replacements are implemented as Python/Bash/Node scripts

title: Make story command implementation-agnostic
story: As a developer, I want the story command to focus purely on user-facing problems and acceptance criteria, so that stories are not polluted with implementation details.
acceptance_criteria: The story command explicitly instructs the agent not to read the codebase
The story command explicitly instructs the agent not to include implementation details in the story or acceptance criteria
Acceptance criteria are written from a user or product perspective, not a technical one
